<!--
  The whole manual as one printable file. Rendered with Quarto's Typst
  backend, which ships inside Quarto --- no TeX install needed.

  Excluded from the website render (see `render:` in _quarto.yml) so it does
  not also become an HTML page. It is built separately and the PDF is copied
  into files/, which the website render then publishes as a resource.
  See .github/workflows/build-manual.yml.

  Every page is pulled from the same source the website uses, so there is one
  copy of the content.

  Two things about `{{< include >}}` that are not obvious:

  1. It merges the included file's YAML front matter into this document, in
     order, last one winning --- so an unguarded title here ends up as
     "Changelog", the last file included. Title and subtitle are therefore
     passed on the command line with -M, which outranks front matter. Keep
     them in the render command, not here.

  2. It does not contribute the included file's title as a heading; that
     front matter is consumed as metadata and never rendered. Without the
     explicit `#` headings below, all twelve modules collapse into one
     undifferentiated run of `##` subsections. The headings are level 1 so
     each page's own `##` headings nest underneath as subsections.

  Module titles are repeated here rather than derived. If you retitle a
  module, update it in both places.
-->
